tools.name: markdown
tools.description: Web page to markdown: read any public URL as clean, LLM-ready Markdown. Strips nav, ads and cookie banners; returns main-content Markdown plus title, author, date and word count. Charged only on success. Price: $0.002 USDC on Base via x402.

tools.name: telegram_search
tools.description: Telegram channel search: find messages in a public Telegram channel by keyword. Returns up to 200 matching posts with date, text, views, reactions, links and media, plus channel title and subscriber count. No login. Charged only on success. Price: $0.005 USDC on Base via x402.

tools.name: youtube_transcript
tools.description: YouTube transcript: full captions/subtitles for one video as clean plain text plus timestamped segments, title, channel, duration and language, with language fallback and translation. Charged only on success. Price: $0.004 USDC on Base via x402.

tools.name: metadata
tools.description: URL metadata / link preview: title, description, Open Graph and Twitter tags, canonical URL, favicon, language, author/dates, RSS/Atom feeds, hreflang, robots and JSON-LD. Fast one-fetch SEO metadata. Charged only on success. Price: $0.001 USDC on Base via x402.

tools.name: sitemap
tools.description: Website sitemap URLs: list every page URL on a site from robots.txt and XML sitemaps (indexes, gzip, text). Up to 5000 URLs with lastmod/changefreq/priority, optional keyword filter; homepage-link fallback. Charged only on success. Price: $0.003 USDC on Base via x402.

tools.name: contacts
tools.description: Website contacts / lead enrichment: company emails (role vs personal, Cloudflare-obfuscated decoded), phones, LinkedIn/X/Instagram/Facebook/YouTube/TikTok, postal address and org name from schema.org. Scans homepage plus up to 5 contact/about pages. Charged only on success. Price: $0.005 USDC on Bas

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "markdown" references sensitive artifacts (cookie). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
